tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the sandbox and return its contents. Use this only for files under the project root; prefer `list_dir` when you need to discover names first. Returns the file body as a string, or an error if the path escapes the sandbox.

path.description: Path relative to the sandbox root; absolute paths are rejected.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List entries in one directory under the sandbox root. Use this only when you need names before calling `read_file`; prefer `search_files` for recursive lookups. Returns a JSON array of {name, type} objects.

path.description: Directory relative to the sandbox root.
